blocks.content:
Earth rotates 360° in 24 hours.
→ 15° longitude equals 1 hour.
→ 1° equals 4 minutes.

items: Remember the key formula for time conversion: 1° longitude equals 4 minutes.
Calculate time zone differences based on the 15° longitude per 1 hour ratio.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Earth completes a full 360° rotation over a period of 24 hours.
A longitudinal shift of 15° is equivalent to a time change of 1 hour.
A single degree (1°) of longitude corresponds to a time difference of 4 minutes.
